methodology.dataset: i=0..n-1; value=(i*37)%1000-500; device=(i*17)%97; late timestamps i-10000 for i%20=0
methodology.storage: durable disk-backed databases; Kestrel uncompressed column segments; DuckDB native compressed table
methodology.api: Rust direct query API vs DuckDB Python binding
methodology.cache: warm medians; first queries and reopen do not clear OS caches; no cold-I/O claim
methodology.indexes: Kestrel built-in sparse prefixes and zonemaps; DuckDB built-in zonemaps, no explicit ART
methodology.memory: Kestrel capped batch and index allocations; DuckDB 256MB buffer manager; measured peak RSS for both
methodology.ingestion: both generated in their child process; timings include generation, maintenance, persistence
limits: single machine and sequential engine order
process RSS excludes shared kernel caches
no distributed execution or general SQL parity
fast aggregate queries validate index metadata and read-block checksums; full scrub separately validates every payload

queries.name: all_aggregates
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS total, AVG(value) AS mean FROM events

queries.name: broad_window
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS total, AVG(value) AS mean FROM events WHERE ts >= 2500000 AND ts < 7500000

queries.name: narrow_window
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS total FROM events WHERE ts >= 9999000 AND ts < 10000000

queries.name: unordered_filter
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(value) AS total FROM events WHERE value >= 0

queries.name: grouped
queries.sql: SELECT device, SUM(value) AS total FROM events GROUP BY device ORDER BY device

queries.name: min_max
queries.sql: SELECT MIN(value) AS smallest, MAX(value) AS largest FROM events WHERE ts >= 5000000

kestrel.memory_measurement: OS peak working set sampled while child is alive; excludes OS file cache and parent process

duckdb.memory_limit: 256MB buffer-manager limit; not a total-process RSS cap
